title: Multimodal Support in Gen AI Studio Playground
assumptions: The screen demonstrates the proposed 10 MB image and audio limit; PM confirmation is pending.
A registered ASR AI Asset and replica-safe temporary file storage are represented as available in the happy path.
Sprint 0 must validate replica-safe storage, OGX image content-part pass-through, and request size limits before implementation.
The accepted product scope is JPG/PNG image upload and WAV/MP3 audio upload. Microphone capture, video, multiple files, mixed image and audio, and persisted multimodal chats are out of scope.
